response.sql: SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) AS avg_acl_igm FROM Patient p LEFT JOIN Examination e ON e.ID = p.ID WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Examination e2 WHERE e2.ID = p.ID AND e2.`ANA Pattern` = 'S') GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX ORDER BY (AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) IS NULL), AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) DESC LIMIT 10;
